design.title: Kefi Tech — AI Transformation for BFSI & Insurance
design.style_name: Kefi Brand v6 + Visual Fixes + REAL Industry-Specific Content
design.logo_discipline: ONE LOGO PER SLIDE. Only slides 1 (cover) and 12 (closing) get the actual Kefi Tech logo image. All other 10 slides use `KEFI TECH`. Foot-rail on EVERY slide uses the text wordmark.

logo.sizing_lock: Width-locked classes with padding-left to prevent logo overlap with brand stripe.

design.v6_fixes_applied: Fix 1 (logo padding-left), Fix 2 (taller COMPONENTS panel 400px), Fix 3 (architecture justify-content space-between), Fix 4 (full capability names on cover), Fix 5 (industry-specific architecture content — 320 real entries).

slides.title: Cover — AI Transformation for BFSI & Insurance
slides.task_brief: Cover slide. Apply .brand-stripe (6px left edge, top 60% #004c97, bottom 40% #ff6c0e). Top-left: `` (260px wide, with 10px left padding to clear brand stripe) at top:64px / left:104px. Top-right: small JetBrains Mono 'AI TRANSFORMATION SERVICES · 2026' in --text-muted. Center-left (~y=240): eyebrow 'KEFI TECH · BFSI & INSURANCE' in --brand; huge display headline at --fs-display (64px) on two stacked lines (Sora 700/800): line 1 'AI Transformation' in --primary, line 2 'for BFSI & Insurance.' in --accent orange. Below headline: thin --accent-bar (48px wide). Below accent-bar: a real subtitle in --text-secondary at --fs-h3: 'A capability brief on Kefi Tech AI Transformation Services for BFSI & Insurance.' Right side: vertical hairline at ~70% width with three stacked JetBrains Mono callouts in --brand. FIX 4: Use FULL capability names (not single words): '01 Generative AI Solutions', '02 Agentic AI & Automation', '03 Enterprise Knowledge & RAG'. Apply .grid-bg subtle background grid. NO secondary stat. NO CTA. Clean and quiet. Bottom rail (.bordered): left `KEFI TECH`; right '01 / 12 · AI TRANSFORMATION SERVICES'.

slides.title: Industry Context — BFSI & Insurance

Sora 700 headline 'BFSI & Insurance operates in a regulated, document-intensive, high-stakes environment.' Subtitle (--text-secondary): 'Customer trust, regulatory compliance, transaction integrity and operational resilience define competitive position.'. Below subtitle: a TWO-COLUMN layout. LEFT column (55% width): a .surface-elev panel (~560px x 360px) titled 'WHY BFSI & INSURANCE NEEDS THIS NOW' (eyebrow in --brand). Below, a stacked list of 4 industry drivers, each as a small .surface card with: Material Icon (20px) in --brand + Sora 600 driver title (13px) + Inter 11px --text-secondary description (2 lines). Verbatim drivers — 'trending_up' 'Digital transformation pressure' / 'Enterprise digital adoption accelerating across the industry.' 'shield' 'Regulatory & compliance demands' / 'Industry-specific regulations require continuous compliance technology.' 'speed' 'Operational efficiency mandate' / 'Cost-to-serve reduction while maintaining quality and resilience.' 'group' 'Customer & employee expectations' / 'Modern digital experiences are now table stakes, not differentiation.' RIGHT column (45% width): a .surface-elev panel (~440px x 360px) titled 'WHAT THIS MEANS FOR AI TRANSFORMATION' (eyebrow in --accent-dark). Below body: a small .tag-pill 'INDUSTRY-SPECIFIC APPROACH' in --brand-soft. Bottom rail (.bordered): left `KEFI TECH`; center '02 / 12'; right 'INDUSTRY CONTEXT'.
